body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Vienna, Austria. It starts at Schönbrunnerstrasse 99.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> During this workshop designed for children and adults, experienced chocolatiers will guide you through the chocolate-making process.
>
> You will learn about the short history of cocoa fruit, the types of chocolate, and the seven steps of chocolate consumption.
>
> After the first part of the workshop, you'll create your own chocolate bars with professional molds and machines.
>
> With various tasty toppings and ingredients served on the marble table, you can garnish and design your chocolate the way you like it.
>
> In the final part of the experience, you will make a traditional Aztec chocolate drink using ancient tools and recipes.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €43.08. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 76 ratings and 41 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
